observations: Photo 0 shows a grey game console with two controllers (one black, one blue) on top.
Photo 1 shows the side of the console with a 'SONY' logo and a disc slot.
Photo 2 shows the top of the console with a 'SONY' logo and a 'PS4' logo.
The console has a matte grey finish, characteristic of the PS4 Slim model.
The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 models.

risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controllers being used to navigate the system menu.
Video of a game disc being inserted and launched.
Video of the console connected to the internet and logged into PSN.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PS4 Slim from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working) until proof of functionality is provided.
